name: Venture firm
blurb: A venture firm's deals, portfolio, people and investment theses, with every signal tied to the beliefs it supports or contradicts.
about: Build a living system of record for a venture firm, and the agent workflows around it. It keeps deals, investment theses and the assumptions under them, signals, meetings, decisions, commitments, and the people and organizations involved linked, so they stay aligned as evidence arrives. Which active theses are contradicted is worked out from the signals each time you ask, so no status drifts from the evidence. Agents capture calls and news and re-check beliefs on branches a partner reviews before anything reaches the baseline.
sample: Quito Capital, a fictional AI-infrastructure fund

questions.q: Which active theses has new evidence contradicted?
